tha-ap340:1.1: Uttareyyadāyaka.] Nagare Haṃsavatiyā āhosiṃ brāhmaṇo tadā / ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇaṃ vedāna pāragū. // //
tha-ap340:2.1: Purakkhato sasissehi jātimā ca susikkhito / toyābhisecanatthāya nagarā nikkhamiṃ tadā. // //
tha-ap340:3.1: Padumuttaro nāma jino sabbadhammāna pāragū / khīṇāsa*vasa*hassehi nagaraṃ pāvisi jino. // //
tha-ap340:4.1: Sucārurūpaṃ disvāna anejaṃ kāritaṃ viya / parivutam arahantehi disvā cittaṃ pasādayiṃ. // //
tha-ap340:5.1: Sirasi añjaliṃ katvā namassitvāna subbataṃ / pasannacitto sumano uttarīyam adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap340:6.1: Ubho hatthehi paggayha sāṭakam ukkhipim ahaṃ / yāvatā Buddhaparisā tāva cchādesi sāṭakaṃ. // //
tha-ap340:7.1: Piṇḍacārañ *caran*tassa mahābhikkhugaṇādinaṃ / chadaṃ karonto aṭṭhāsi hāsayanto maman tadā. // //
tha-ap340:8.1: Gharato nikkhamantassa sayambhū aggapuggalo / vīṭhiyaṃ 'va ṭhito satthā akā me anumodanaṃ: // //
tha-ap340:9.1: Pasannacitto sumano yo me *pādāsi sāṭa*kaṃ / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap340:10.1: ‘Tiṃsakappasahassāni devaloke ramissati / paññāsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjaṃ karissati. // //
tha-ap340:12.1: Chattiṃsakkhattuṃ rājā *ca* cakkavatti bhavissati / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
tha-ap340:13.1: Bhave saṃsāramāṇassa puññakammasamaṅgino / manasā patthitaṃ sabbaṃ nibbattissati tāvade. // //
tha-ap340:14.1: Koseyyakambalāni ca khomakappāsikāni ca / mahagghāni ca dussāni paṭilacchati yaṃ naro. // //
tha-ap340:15.1: Manasā patthitaṃ sabbaṃ paṭilacchati yaṃ naro / ekadussassa vipākam anubhossati sabbadā. // //
tha-ap340:16.1: So pacchā pabbajitvāna sukkamūlena codito / Gotamassa bhagavato dhammaṃ sacchikarissati.' // //
tha-ap340:17.1: Aho me sukataṃ kammaṃ sabbaññussa mahesino / ekāhaṃ sāṭakaṃ datvā patto 'mhi amataṃ padaṃ. // //
tha-ap340:18.1: Maṇḍape rukkhamūle vā vasato suññake ghare / dhāreti dussacchadanaṃ samantāvyāmato mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap340:19.1: Aviññatti nisevāmi cīvaraṃ paccayañ ca 'haṃ / lābhī hi annapānassa uttareyyass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap340:20.1: Satasahasse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi vatthadānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap340:22.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Uttareyyadāyako thero i. g. a-ti.
